text.p: Wasatch Constructors, a joint venture of Kiewit Construction Co, Granite Construction Co and Washington Construction Co, said Wednesday it had won a contract to rebuild a Utah highway.
Wasatch spokesman Greg Brooks said the contract was worth $1.325 billion and was for a period of four-and-a-half years.

The project entails final design and construction of 16 miles of Interstate 15 through Salt Lake City and surrounding communities. Reconstruction will include reconfiguration of interchanges and widening the existing freeway to six lanes in each direction, the company said.

Kiewit Construction Co is one of the nation's largest general contractors. Granite Construction Co is a highway and heavy civil construction general contractor and Washington Construction Co, a highway and heavy civil general engineering contractor, recently completed its merger with the Morrison Knudsen Corp.
